headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs with an 18-3 victory, led by Matt Chapman's two home runs and eight RBIs. Robbie Ray earned the win with 5.0 innings of scoreless relief.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players landing on the injured list. The Colorado Rockies' Tanner Gordon has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip impingement, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026. The San Diego Padres' Jeremiah Estrada has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right knee inflammation, while Ramón Laureano has been transferred to the 60-day injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Boston Red Sox acquiring left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, while the Atlanta Braves acquired catcher Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded right-handed pitcher Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and also traded right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Cubs 18-3 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 18-3 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Matt Chapman leading the charge at the plate. Chapman's impressive outing included two home runs and eight RBIs, while Robbie Ray earned the win with 5.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Tigers in 7-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Framber Valdez earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Kerry Carpenter led the Tigers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the Chicago White Sox 8-6, securing a hard-fought win. Randal Grichuk led the White Sox offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Yankees 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Sonny Gray earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Tanner Gordon Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Tanner Gordon has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip impingement, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **La Sorsa Joins Red Sox**
top_news.summary: Left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa has been traded to the Boston Red Sox. The move comes after the Pittsburgh Pirates dealt La Sorsa to the Red Sox.
